name: Christoffel
beschreibung: Hotel Christoffel is located in the Tiroler Bezirk Landeck, near Sankt Anton am Arlberg. The surroundings are characterized by mountain peaks and alpine meadows and invite you to enjoy outdoor activities. The amenities include cozy rooms with balcony as well as a sauna and a steam bath. The dining room and lounge areas are traditional in style. The atmosphere is quiet and family-friendly, suitable for those seeking relaxation and active holidaymakers.
